latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Video Generator Freepik.
- Instantly turns up to three Freepik images into a 1080p animated MP4 video using simple prompts.
- Automatic backend setup: connects, authenticates, and creates a session for each user.
- Supports quick uploads, video generation, export, balance check, and state query via simple commands.
- No manual editing needed: describe your desired result and download the final video in 1-2 minutes.
- Free up to 100 credits; accepts JPG, PNG, WEBP, SVG images up to 200MB.
